build_DepthNet: build a DepthNet encoder with resnet50 backbone for monocular depth estimation
build_Decoder: build a Decoder module that fuses multi-scale features into a depth map
build_FFM: build a Feature Fusion Module to combine low-level and high-level features with upsampling
build_FTB: build a Feature Transformation Block with residual convolution for feature processing
build_AO: build an Adaptive Output module that produces single-channel depth predictions
